name: higgsfield
tagline_zh: 写提示词总被模型无视？这个技能懂 Kling、Sora、Veo 等 12+ 模型，还内置镜头预设和角色一致性。
tagline_en: Tired of prompts models ignore? This skill knows 12+ models, camera presets, and character consistency—so every.
desc_en: Use this skill whenever the user asks anything about Higgsfield AI — writing or refining video/image prompts, choosing a model (Kling, Sora 2, Veo, Wan, Seedance, Minimax Hailuo, DoP, Soul, Nano Banana, Seedream, Flux, GPT Image, etc.), camera controls, named motion presets, Soul ID character consistency, Cinema Studio 2.5/3.0, Vibe Motion, troubleshooting failed generations, credit optimization,
why_zh: 同类只会给模板，它内置各模型的隐藏参数和失败排查，连积分优化都替你算好。
why_en: Unlike generic templates, it includes model-specific hidden params, failure troubleshooting, and credit optimization built-in.
